requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} mentioned that the risk assessment can remain manual for this release.
requirement.reading: She would accept the risk assessment remaining manual if the acceptance criteria are automated to manual checks.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: You are treating my manual risk assessment as a feature you can simply strip away, but I need that trade off explicitly acknowledged in the release notes. If you remove the manual layer, you must tell the team that the safety net is gone, not just that the checklist changed.
output.correction: I did not say the risk assessment is fine to stay manual forever, I said it can remain manual for this specific release only if the acceptance criteria are handled by automated checks. You filed that as a permanent preference, but it is a temporary concession tied to a specific technical condition.
